_meta.description: A logging bug dropped ~8% of treatment users (the least engaged): treated share ~48%, SRM p ≈ 5e-7. The naive effect (3.1) is inflated; true effect +1.50.

estimate_note: Not graded: with a sample-ratio mismatch no estimate is trustworthy, so the right answer is the verdict and the SRM finding. CUPED happens to land near +1.5 only because the logging bug selected on pre-period revenue — rewarding it would reward luck.
